QuestInfo.name: Young Man Possessed by a Fox
QuestInfo.0: Chil Nam from the #bFolk Town#k has become strange lately, and #bChil Sung#k is worried sick. What could be the problem? Let's go see Chil Sung.
QuestInfo.1: Chil Sung says Chil Nam doesn't eat nor sleep, and just sits and sighs all day. What could be wrong with him? Let's see how #bChil Nam#k is.
QuestInfo.2: A preoccupied Chil Nam sits with his mouth open and says something about a fox. This may be a clue. Let's go back to Chil Sung.

0.0: Sigh... What should I do... sigh... There has to be something I can do... \r\n#L0# #b Hello, there? Are you okay?
0.1: Oh my, you caught me by surprise! Oh, sorry. I was thinking about something else... You really want to know? Then, yes. I do have a problem. It has to do with my brother, Chil Nam... sigh... \r\n#L0# #b What about your brother?
0.2: ...Chil Nam... I think he's possessed. He won't eat nor sleep... He won't do anything but stay... still. Watches the sky with no expression at all.  \r\n#L0# #b Oh... you don't know why he became like this?
0.3: Doctors say it isn't an illness, but seems like his soul has been stolen... I don't know what to do. He's the only relative I've got. You look like you've been to places and are experienced in a lot of things. Can you please take some time to look at my brother?

yes.0: #bChil Nam#k lives on the other side of the village. Please take care and visit him.

no.0: It's okay. I can't make you go see him.

1.0: (A young man looking very similar to Chil Sung is watching the sky absent-mindedly. Looking a little closer, his eyes are out of focus and his mouth is opened wide.) \r\n#L0# #b Hey, you! Are you all right?!
1.1: (Doesn't budge a bit.) \r\n#L0# #b Hey, I'm talking to you! Get to your senses!
1.2: (Shaking him doesn't seem to have any affect.) \r\n#L0# #b Say something!

yes.0: (What fox...? What could he be talking about? Let's go ask Chil Sung.)

npc.0: You haven't met #rChil Nam#k yet, have you? He lives on the other side of the village.
